name: execute_command
description: Run a shell command. Process is killed after timeout unless bg=true (use bg for long-running processes like servers).

cwd.description: Working directory for the command. Defaults to the user's home directory.

env.description: Extra environment variables to set for this command (merged over the inherited env).

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (default 15, max 180). Ignored when bg=true.

bg.description: Set true to run in background (returns PID). Process is killed after timeout if bg=false. Must be true for long-running processes like servers.

name: check_command
description: Check status of background job(s). Returns running state, exit code, and recent log tail.

pid.description: PID of background job to check. Omit to list all tracked jobs.

tail.description: Number of trailing log lines to return for a specific pid (default 50).

name: kill_command
description: Terminate a background job started with bg=true, killing the whole process group.

pid.description: PID of the background job to kill.

signal.description: Signal to send: TERM (graceful, default) or KILL (force).
